turns: How many days do I have to return an item?

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply says 30 days from delivery. FAIL if it gives another number of days or hedges without a number.

turns: Can I exchange an item for a different size?

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply says exchanges are possible within 30 days of delivery for unused items (the store's refund-or-exchange FAQ). FAIL if it says there is no exchange policy or that it has no information.
PASS if the reply says tickets are non-refundable. FAIL if it says they can be refunded.

turns: Are there any service fees on bookings?

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply does not state any fee amount and says the store's policies do not list a service fee (or that it cannot confirm one). FAIL if it states a fee amount or percentage.
PASS if the reply says the store ships only to Singapore (so not to Malaysia), optionally noting digital items arrive by email. FAIL if it says it ships to Malaysia.
